answer: Each identity may enqueue two work claims per epoch free; every extra claim must clear a 0.50-unit escrow ridge and publish a crystal digest of its output. Extras enter a side queue keyed by digest; at epoch 6 an auditor re-derives the item: a byte-exact match releases the escrow after 12 epochs, a mismatch burns it. The cap flattens the tide of burst submissions so farms cannot crowd out honest claims. Cost: N identities get 2N free slots; M extra fakes escrow 0.50M units, fake work never re-derives, so all M escrows burn: outlay 0.50M, return 0; honest agents pay nothing.
